title: Not at all what I thought it was when I saw the picture
text: Not at all what I thought it was when I saw the picture. I honestly think these are a total ripoff, I mean the stones are okay for a fish tank maybe? wait no...for a fish bowl... actually and maybe just barely. The amount of these is too few they are TINY! And I mean TINY, it's okay but maybe I should have checked the reviews better before I bought this I am convinced this is for fish now after I bought it it just doesn't look good enough for decoration or anything really... and to top all of that off the amount you get is just hilarious, it fits on one hand I mean it's not like really small but it is quite small and looks bad quality, I guess I will inspect them better before I make my final review but ... so far they don't look great and the bag they came in looked very old as well and darkened. I know I was looking for something a little cheaper for this but this item is just... bad... I don't know. I feel like it was a waste of my time to buy this.
